main_text.p: tica, omnino vetitum. Sic enim lex hac de re habuit: Si peregrinus mulierem civem Atticam duxerit quacunque arte aut machinatione,quivis Atheniensium, cui id licet, eum apud Thesmothetas accusato. Qui si damnatus fuerit, venundetur tum ipse, tum res eius familiaris: & triens esto eius, qui reum peregerit. Si-militer si & peregrina civi Attico nupserit, pari ratione & etiam qui peregrinitatis damnatam habuerit in matrimonio, mille drachmis multctator. Cui legi altera affinis in eadem oratione contra Neæram recitata est ista: Si quis viro Atheniensi peregrinam mulierem pro sua, id est, ex se genita, elocaverit sive desponderit, ignominiosus esto: & eius res familiaris publicator, & triens esto eius, qui ipsum convicerit: arcessitor autem apud Thesmothetas ab aliquo ex iis, quibus licet, velut peregrinitatis. Et rursum alia ibidem: Qui adulterum cum uxore sua deprehendit, ei non liceat eandem in matrimonio retinere: si retinuerit, & cum ea porro consueverit, ignominiosus habetor. Foemina deprehensa sina publica ingredi prohibetor ne sacra prophanet aut polluat: & si contempta lege ingressa fuerit, a quovis impune male multctator, vitâ solummodò incolumi. Solonis vero lex fuit, quam Plutarchus memora-[illegible, ~6 letters][illegible, ~5 letters][illegible, ~8 letters]

page.notes: The right margin carries very small note marks beside several lines of the paragraph (near "damnatus", "ejus res", "Foemina", "impune" and at the end of the page). They are too faint to read, so they are shown as illegible placeholders. Their exact positions are approximate. Words marked as doubtful in the text are the Latin "mulctator", which is printed with an abbreviation mark I could not resolve, and "sina" for "sive". The printed "Si-militer" and "nu-pserit" and "in-gressa" keep their line-end hyphens. The printed "Thefmothetas" and "accufato" were given the plain s, and "ejus" was changed to "eius" per the i/j rule. The bottom right corner shows a library stamp, which is omitted. The left margin shows only show-through and edge marks, which are omitted.
